The single large circular lesion with clear concentric rings on tomato fruit is highly characteristic of **Anthracnose** (Colletotrichum coccodes). This pathogen causes circular, sunken lesions on ripe tomato fruits that develop concentric ring patterns with dark centers and lighter tan/cream surrounding zones as they mature - exactly matching the test image.
